# Opening libraries and reading data

```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

homicides <- read_csv("data/homicide-data.csv")

head(homicides)
str(homicides)

```

# cleaning and preparing data

```{r data}

colnames(homicides)

baltimore_monthly <- homicides %>%
  filter(city == "Baltimore", state == "MD") %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(reported_date),
         month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(homicides = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(season = if_else(
    month(month) %in% 5:10,
    "Summer",
    "Winter"
  ))

head(baltimore_monthly)


```

# creating the plot 

```{r plot}

ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) + 
  geom_col(aes(fill = season))

```

# changing the season colors 

```{r}


ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue"))


```


# adding smooth line to help show trends 

```{r smooth line}


ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Summer" = "grey",
    "Winter" = "lightblue"
  )) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  )


```


# vertical reference line 

```{r vertical line}


ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  )


```


```{r text insert}


ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
           y = 50, label = "Freddie Gray arrested", color = "red", 
           hjust = -0.1,
           size = 3)

```

# adding plot title and labels 

```{r customizing plot}



ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
           y = 50, label = "Freddie Gray arrested", color = "red", 
           hjust = -0.1,
           size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Homicides in Baltimore, MD",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Monthly Homicides",
    fill = NULL
  )


```

# changing background color and grid 
```{r more customizing}

ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
           y = 50, label = "Arrest of Freddie Gray", color = "white", 
           hjust = -0.1,
           size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Homicides in Baltimore, MD",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Monthly Homicides",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey50"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey50"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey35"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

# adjusting plot format

```{r changing plot format}

ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
           y = 50, label = "Arrest of Freddie Gray", color = "white", 
           hjust = -0.1,
           size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Homicides in Baltimore, MD",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Monthly Homicides",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray50"),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray45"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray48"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm")
)

```

# adujsting arrest text position and formatting 

```{r text edits}

) 

```


# changing graph formatting 

```{r graph formatting}

ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = season)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "gray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) + 
   geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.1,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-12"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
   annotate(
  "text",
  x = as.Date("2015-03-12"),
  y = 40,
  label = "Arrest of\nFreddie Gray",
  color = "gray90",
  hjust = 1,
  size = 4
) +
labs(
  title = "Homicides in Baltimore, MD",
  x = "Date",
  y = "Monthly homicides",
  fill = NULL
) +
  scale_x_date(
  date_breaks = "2 years",
  date_labels = "%Y"
) +
scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = seq(0, 40, 10)
) +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray50"),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray45"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray48"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm")
) 

```
